local_cultural_transfer_analysis.causal_caution: Local transfer and root event studies are observational. They identify where to place paired checkpoint interventions, not causal effects.

resource_demand_analysis.interpretation: Raw channel volumes co-move with population and HARVEST action count. Share-composition metrics remove that common scale before measuring demand differentiation. Realized extraction remains availability-limited; explicit requested-channel metrics are authoritative. Older selective runs without requested-channel fields cannot reconstruct channel composition.
